title: The Great Journey
description: Short board: Start + tiles 1-100 + END (101 tiles after Start). Same journey as v1-long, scaled to half length by tools/sim/make-short.mjs.

end.title: Festival of Lights
end.text: You made it to the Festival of Lights!

5.title: Forgot your ticket
5.text: Run back home to get it.

7.title: Busy crossing
7.text: Next turn you move just 1 square.

12.title: Bus arrives
12.text: The bus comes right away - throw once more!

15.title: Flat tyre
15.text: Fix your bike: move on with a 4, 5 or 6 (at most 2 tries).

17.title: Tractor ride
17.text: A friendly farmer drives you to the forest.

20.title: Hot-air balloon
20.text: Float over the fields to the river!

22.title: Four-leaf clover
22.text: Throw twice and move the total.

25.title: Rainstorm
25.text: Shelter in the barn - skip 2 turns.

27.title: Forest railway
27.text: Ride the little train to Forest Station.

30.title: Umbrella
30.text: Keep this card: it can protect you from one setback.

32.title: Trail marker
32.text: Follow the marker to the next boost and use it.

37.title: Shared ride
37.text: Swap places with the traveller just ahead of you.

40.title: Canoe trip
40.text: Paddle downstream to the river beach.

42.title: Boat ride
42.text: Sail across the lake to the river beach path.

45.title: Compass
45.text: Keep this card: throw again once when you like.

47.title: Bridge repairs
47.text: Wait 1 turn while the bridge is fixed.

48.title: Path through the reeds
48.text: Take the shortcut? Throw: 4-6 you jump ahead, 1-3 you wait 1 turn. Or stay on the path.

50.title: Wrong turn
50.text: You took the wrong path around the lake - go back.

53.title: Mountain bus
53.text: Take the bus up the first bends of the mountain road.

54.title: Cable car
54.text: Ride up now and skip your next turn - or keep walking.

56.title: Muddy slide
56.text: Whoops! Slide back down to the lake shore.

58.title: Goat path
58.text: A mountain goat shows you a shortcut.

61.title: Snowball
61.text: Roll like a snowball: throw twice and move the total.

63.title: Thick fog
63.text: You get lost in the fog: go to the next setback and take it.

66.title: Lodge is full
66.text: No room tonight - walk back down a little.

68.title: Great Snake Slide
68.text: Ride the Great Snake down to the beach - you become the Snake Leader!

71.title: Photo stop
71.text: You stop for photos - everyone else doubles their next throw.

72.title: Beach umbrella
72.text: Keep this card: it can protect you from one setback.

73.title: Ferry delayed
73.text: Move on with a 4, 5 or 6 (at most 2 tries).

76.title: Beach buggy
76.text: Catch a buggy ride - swap places with the traveller just ahead of you.

78.title: Sleepy snake
78.text: A sleepy snake carries you back along the beach.

81.title: Green lights
81.text: All traffic lights are green - throw once more!

83.title: Invitation
83.text: You are invited to the City Fair!

84.title: City map
84.text: Keep this card: throw again once when you like.

91.title: Wrong tram
91.text: Oops, wrong tram - ride back to the City Fair.

93.title: Wrong exit
93.text: You took the wrong exit - wait 1 turn to find the way.

94.title: Last hill
94.text: Sprint ahead now (next turn you move just 1) - or walk.

96.title: Forgot keys!
96.text: Run back a little to get your keys.

98.title: Forgot keys AGAIN!!!
98.text: Wait 1 turn while a friend brings them.

100.title: Snake Leader's duty
100.text: Snake Leaders only: follow the snake back to the city.
